node.title: XR graded tangent band charge (ratified Route T third generic column): band-column slope count <= 4n^3 with the cascade tier d = h-1 named inside [1, h-1]
node.statement: At each of the six clean-rate candidates, for every globally generic-branch received pair (u,v): |Gamma_band| = #{post-strip live slopes whose selected agreement support shares a core of size in [k+1, A-1] with another live member} <= 4n^3, charged to the THIRD generic column from the 13n^3 consumption headroom (16n^3 + 4n^3 = 20n^3 <= 29n^3 proved allowance; B_tan untouched at n-A+1; the 8n^3 + 8n^3 reserves never split — AZC margin 0.5005%). Depth grading d = core - k in [1, h-1]; the depth-(h-1) CASCADE TIER is a NAMED tier of this column (fold-in ratified 2026-08-02), so xr_pencil_cascade's forcing stays citable as structure while its charge lives here. Reduction of record (banked pilots, coordinator-verified): |Gamma_band| = Sum_d Sum_P L_P, TIGHT at the cascade tier (k-packing exclusivity), L_P <= floor((n-J)/(A-J)); under the BAND OCCUPANCY LEMMA (N_d <= ~0.68n^2 at every band depth; sharpened SHARP-OCC: N_d <= floor((n-k+1)/(h-d)) at d <= (h-1)/2, <= floor((2(n-k)-1)/(2h-2)) above, hence <= n/2; sharpest calibration RowC 1/4 U-mechanism N_1 = 510 vs 512) the column prices at <= ~0.57n^2 — 2^46 inside the headroom. Cost side PROVED: two-slope condition rank exactly 2h per pair (FAMILY-RANK; per-ray accounting of record); sunflower cost exactly h (unique known deficit family, d <= (h-1)/2 only); connectivity floor rank >= m = |union S| - k (V <= m/2 => occupancy); MC depth-quantized out of the band; calibration adversaries K_V, MC, U-mechanism. THE SINGLE OPEN INPUT is the occupancy lemma; heart OF RECORD (re-posed 2026-08-03, ratified; iterated-core form, item 12'): 'every ray of the (3,k+1)-core escapes >= 2 points relative to W_infinity' => per-ray charge >= 2 is PROVED (U5); OPEN = admissible band systems satisfy the hypothesis; only defeat channels: V >= 5 zero-escape below the Cor-3b threshold ((V-3)t + |A_0| <= k-1), and escape-1 core rays — escape-0 at V = 4 SETTLED (charge >= 2, Prop 6); former sub-items (zero-escape collapse rank = 2m; V <= m/2) REFUTED as general statements and STRUCK, fixture collapses surviving as theorems. See critical/nodes/xr_graded_tangent_band_charge/statement.md and notes/BAND_LANE_DEFINITIONS.md.
